critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: High tide backflow through Love Grove sluice gates; storm runoff trapped by coastal surge.

critical_landmarks.name: Kurla Mithi River Sluice Regulator
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Mithi river crest exceeds 4.2m; reverse tidal surge inundates railway tracks at Kurla Junction.

critical_landmarks.name: Andheri Subway Lowland Corridor
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Natural depression basin overwhelmed by Western Express Highway surface runoff.

critical_landmarks.name: Bandra Kurla Financial Hub Power Feeder
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Basement transformer flooding in commercial complex; backup generators flooded.

critical_landmarks.name: KEM & Sion Trauma Hospital Hub
critical_landmarks.failure_mechanism: Access roads inundated; ground floor outpatient and trauma bays face water ingress.

cloudburst.title: Coastal Cloudburst & Extreme 4.8m Spring Tide Surge

cascade_timeline.desc: 115 mm/hr cloudburst coincides with 4.8m spring tide; sea outfall flap gates forced closed.
Mithi river breaches embankments; Kurla and Sion railway tracks submerged under 1.2m water.
Western Express Highway and Eastern Freeway stalled; airport transit routes cut.
Andheri and Milan subways completely submerged; distribution transformers disconnected.

directives.details: Operate all 6 submersible pump arrays at full 36,000 liters/sec capacity.

directives.action: Halt Suburban Railway Operations on Lowland Sections
directives.details: Divert commuters to elevated Metro lines and municipal bus shuttles.

directives.action: Emergency Coastal Evacuation to High Ground
directives.details: Evacuate 35,000 residents to municipal secondary schools on Bandra ridge.

upstream_dam_release.title: Tulsi & Vihar Lakes Emergency Spillway Overflow

cascade_timeline.desc: Vihar Lake breaches spillway crest; 45,000 cusecs discharged into Mithi river.
Saki Naka and Kurla industrial units flooded; chemical runoff enters stream.

directives.details: Deploy hydraulic dredgers to break floating silt and plastic debris dams.

cascade_timeline.desc: High rodent population and contaminated runoff create acute leptospirosis cluster.
KEM, Sion, and Nair hospitals report 100% ICU bed occupancy.

directives.details: Distribute 200,000 preventative antibiotic doses via community health workers.

heatwave_grid_stress.title: Coastal Humidity Heat Index Exceedance (52°C Apparent)

cascade_timeline.stage: Humid Heat Stress & AC Grid Peak
cascade_timeline.desc: High humidity pushes heat index to 52°C; suburban distribution transformers overheat.

directives.action: Activate Railway Station AC Cooling Zones
directives.details: Open transit concourses for heat exhaustion first aid.

cascade_timeline.desc: Tidal gates operating routinely; suburban rail and arterial corridors running on timetable.

directives.details: Verify hydraulic rams and tidal backflow flap seals.
